period_note: THIN/FLAGGED QUARTER - unaudited interim financial performance, discrete Jul-Sep 2021. The source DSE table's Q3 and 9-Months columns for this bank contain a data-quality problem which is preserved here rather than silently resolved: the 'Turnover/Revenue', 'Profit from continuing operations', 'Profit for the period', and 'Total Comprehensive Income' cells all read exactly 0 for Q3 (not credible as four unrelated genuine reported zeros in the same quarter for a bank that had just reported ~180mn cumulative profit through H1) - these are treated as 'not disclosed to DSE in this structured field' and DELIBERATELY OMITTED from line_items below rather than recorded as a fabricated/misleading zero. The 9-Months cumulative versions of these same four rows carry an explicit DSE tooltip: "Mismatch is due to issuers own actual disclosure" (verbatim; DSE's own system attributing the inconsistency to Rupali Bank's own filed disclosure, not a DSE processing error) - also omitted from line_items for the same reason, but recorded in full in the source text file for transparency. The ONE genuinely distinct, non-zero, non-flagged figure for Q3 itself is EPS Basic = -0.030 (a small per-share loss) - this IS recorded below since it is a specific, credible, directly-reported value, unlike the suspicious flat zeros. The 9-Months cumulative EPS (0.370) carries the same DSE mismatch tooltip as the other 9M figures and does NOT reconcile with Half-Yearly EPS (0.430) + this quarter's EPS (-0.030) = 0.400 (a 0.030 BDT/share gap) - flagged here per this dataset's 'prefer contemporaneous, flag don't fabricate' rule, and also OMITTED from line_items given DSE's own explicit mismatch flag. Market price at period end (36.4) is clean/unflagged and recorded. Same Solo-basis-presumed caveat as 2020_Q1.json.
